args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.0) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy (error rate 0.18). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required.
